# Data inventory

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_reference_docs.py from src/adintel/storage/collections.py -->

Every collection AdIntel stores, from the catalogue that also drives indexes and the retention purge.
PII, sources and who may read each kind of data: [data map](data-map.md). How deletion works:
[privacy and data lifecycle](privacy-and-data-lifecycle.md).

| Collection | Purpose | Tenant-scoped | Retention | Purged by | Time field |
|------------|---------|---------------|-----------|-----------|------------|
| `tenants` | Agencies | no (system) | indefinite | kept | — |
| `brands` | Client brands | yes | indefinite | kept | — |
| `users` | People, roles, approval limits | yes | indefinite | kept | — |
| `metrics_daily` | Normalised daily rows (time series) | yes | 25 months | daily purge | date |
| `metrics_rollups` | Pre-computed daily rollups | yes | 25 months | daily purge | date |
| `runs` | Run records | yes | 24 months | daily purge | created_at |
| `run_checkpoints` | RunState after every step | yes | 30 days | daily purge | created_at |
| `run_events` | Progress events streamed to the UI (SSE) | yes | 30 days | daily purge | at |
| `run_history` | Episodic memory: anomalies, actions, outcomes | yes | 24 months | daily purge | created_at |
| `anomalies` | Detected anomalies and lifecycle | yes | 24 months | daily purge | created_at |
| `recommendations` | Proposed actions and approval state | yes | 24 months | daily purge | created_at |
| `approvals` | Signed approval records | yes | 7 years | daily purge | approved_at |
| `executions` | Platform writes actually made | yes | 7 years | daily purge | executed_at |
| `reports` | Generated reports | yes | 24 months | daily purge | created_at |
| `audit_log` | Append-only hash-chained audit | yes | 7 years | never (archived) | — |
| `llm_calls` | One record per model call | yes | 13 months | daily purge | created_at |
| `prompt_archive` | Full prompts and responses by hash | yes | 13 months | daily purge | created_at |
| `cost_events` | Cost per tenant, brand, agent | yes | 25 months | daily purge | day |
| `brand_rules` | Constraints + procedural memory | yes | indefinite | kept | — |
| `rule_proposals` | Suppression rules awaiting approval | yes | indefinite | kept | — |
| `platform_connections` | Ad-account links (secret refs only) | yes | indefinite | kept | — |
| `kb_chunks` | RAG knowledge base | yes | indefinite, versioned | kept | — |
| `chat_sessions` | Conversational memory | yes | 90 days | daily purge | created_at |
| `kill_switches` | Global/tenant/brand/agent switches | no (system) | indefinite | kept | — |
| `notifications` | Alerts and approval-queue notices | yes | 90 days | daily purge | created_at |
| `feedback` | Ratings, rejections, modifications (flywheel) | yes | 24 months | daily purge | created_at |
| `feature_flags` | Per-tenant / per-brand rollout flags | yes | indefinite | kept | — |
| `outcomes` | Actual vs predicted impact, 14 days after each executed change | yes | 7 years | daily purge | measured_at |
| `access_grants` | Break-glass elevation requests and grants | yes | 7 years | daily purge | requested_at |
| `scim_tokens` | Hashed SCIM provisioning tokens per tenant | yes | indefinite | kept | — |
| `shadow_results` | Challenger model outputs compared with the champion (never used) | yes | 90 days | daily purge | created_at |
| `schema_migrations` | Which data migrations ran, when, with what code checksum | no (system) | indefinite | kept | — |
| `eval_datasets` | Golden scenarios | no (system) | versioned | kept | — |
| `secret_access_log` | Who read which secret reference | no (system) | 13 months | daily purge | at |
